🗳️ Election update: 80% of voting districts are now counted (19,039 of 23,696). All figures are provisional.

National (proportional ballot): ANC 32.0%, DA 24.3%, MK 9.3%, EFF 6.2%, ActionSA 5.1%, IFP 4.9%. MK has moved up as more KwaZulu-Natal votes come in. Turnout is about 51%, according to the IEC.

All 8 metros now have results:
🏙️ Johannesburg: DA 39.8%, ANC 17.7%, ActionSA 16.5%
🏛️ Tshwane: DA 31.1%, ActionSA 25.0%, ANC 22.0%
🏭 Ekurhuleni: DA 29.5%, ANC 22.1%, ActionSA 19.8%
🌊 Cape Town: DA 61.3%, ANC 10.3%
🌴 eThekwini: MK 41.4%, DA 23.5%, ANC 16.7%
🌅 Nelson Mandela Bay: DA 44.9%, ANC 25.7%
🏞️ Buffalo City: ANC 41.9%, UDM 20.1%, DA 16.3% (almost fully counted)
🌾 Mangaung: DA 35.8%, ANC 32.7%, EFF 8.1%

What it means for your pocket: Cape Town is the only metro where one party has more than half the vote. The other seven are heading for coalitions, and those deals will decide who sets your property rates, water and electricity tariffs and service budgets for the next five years.

The IEC plans to announce the official results on Sunday, 8 November.

Which metro's coalition talks will you be watching? 👇

sources: Provisional, IEC data via esp.info checked 11:50 SAST 6 Nov 2026: national 19,039/23,696 VDs (80.3%), PR ballot ANC 32.0, DA 24.3, MKP 9.3, EFF 6.2, ActionSA 5.1, IFP 4.9; IEC turnout 51.1%. Metros (PR): Joburg 425/862 DA 39.8 ANC 17.7 ActionSA 16.5; Tshwane 563/796 DA 31.1 ActionSA 25.0 ANC 22.0; Ekurhuleni DA 29.5 ANC 22.1 ActionSA 19.8; Cape Town 500/829 DA 61.3 ANC 10.3; eThekwini 397/839 MKP 41.4 DA 23.5 ANC 16.7; NMB 230/268 DA 44.9 ANC 25.7; Buffalo City 377/380 ANC 41.9 UDM 20.1 DA 16.3; Mangaung 302/388 DA 35.8 ANC 32.7 EFF 8.1. 'Heading for coalitions' = no party above 50% of PR vote so far (seat totals include wards). Official results Sunday 8 Nov: Novanews (IEC).
